gpt-oss-120b.why: No first-party API serves gpt-oss-120b. The published checkpoint is itself MXFP4 on the MoE weights, and Together states MXFP4.

glm-5.3.why: Hyperbolic states bf16, the precision of the published weights. Z.ai's own API does not say which weights or precision it serves.

deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017.why: No listed provider states full precision. DeepSeek's own API names DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 as the model behind deepseek-flash; it does not state a precision.
